rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a process of growth or change and for new developments in the news.

example.english: There’s a new development in this news story.
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 jau5 go3 san1 faat3 zin2

rows.note: Use this for developing products, technologies, or practical applications, often in compounds such as 產品開發.

example.english: This team is working on the development of a new smartphone.
example.traditional: 呢個團隊正開發一款新手機。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi6 zing3 hoi1 faat3 jat1 fun2 san1 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the biological growth and formation of an organism or body part.

example.english: The fetus’s development is going quite well.
example.jyutping: go3 toi1 ji4 faat3 juk6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for a property-development project consisting of residential or commercial buildings.

example.english: This development includes two shopping centres and one residential tower.
example.traditional: 呢個發展項目包括兩座商場同一座住宅大樓。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 zin2 hong6 muk6 baau1 kut3 loeng5 zo6 soeng1 coeng4 tung4 jat1 zo6 zyu6 zaak6 daai6 lau4
